_meta.purpose: Crop reference table read by app/services/crops.py and scored by app/services/suitability.py.
_meta.do_not_hand_edit: Generated file. Edit the sources listed below and re-run the builder.

ecocrop.citation: FAO EcoCrop crop environmental requirements database, Land & Water Division

fao56.citation: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Chapter 6 (Tables 11 and 12)
fao56.note: Tables 11 and 12 are transcribed into scripts/build_crop_table.py with the exact row labels used.

curated.citation: app/data/crop_agronomy_curated.json - judgement fields, kept separate and labelled

package_of_practices.citation: app/data/sources/pop_transcribed.json - Maharashtra package-of-practices, transcribed verbatim from government/ICAR publications (NFSM 2018, DCD Cotton Ready Reckoner, ICAR-IISR 2023)
package_of_practices.note: Adds the advisory 'pop' block (sowing window, seed rate, fertilizer dose) to transcribed crops only; also records local soil-preference overrides. Crops without a transcription carry no pop block.

_meta.verification_summary: The fields that drive a recommendation now come from cited sources instead of hand-written placeholders: soil_texture and temperature ranges from EcoCrop, KC values from FAO-56 Table 12, durations from FAO-56 Table 11 (EcoCrop crop cycle where FAO-56 has no row), and water_need_class derived from Kc x duration. seasons, investment_level and major_risks remain curated judgement and are labelled as such per field.

scoring_semantics.null_soil_types: means the source records no texture preference; the soil factor is reported unavailable and its weight redistributed, not scored as a pass
scoring_semantics.combined: app/services/suitability.py:soil_compatibility reads these lists; it no longer infers credit from water-retention similarity

removed_fields.water_need_mm: Removed in schema 2. It was a hand-written millimetre range with no source. EcoCrop's rainfall_optimal_mm / rainfall_absolute_mm replace it, and they mean something different: the annual rainfall of the environment the crop grows in, not the crop's water requirement. A real per-farm requirement needs ETo and effective rainfall, which is not implemented.
removed_fields.sowing_months: Removed in schema 2. Hand-written and wrong to model as a fixed month list. A real sowing window needs a local package-of-practices source; EcoCrop's planting dates are for other regions. Partially reversed since: transcribed crops carry a 'pop' block with a sourced sowing window (VERBATIM_QUOTE); the scoring engine still does not read it - seasons drive seasonal fit.
removed_fields.harvest_months: Removed in schema 2, same reason as sowing_months.

local_review_needed.issue: FAO-56 Table 12 has no pigeon-pea row; the dry-beans/pulses row is used as a proxy.
Texture came from a second EcoCrop record (Saccharum barberi). A crop specialist should confirm the substitution.
EcoCrop requires poorly (saturated >50% of year), which no soil in this table records for this crop's texture class. The MVP treats drainage as advisory only.
EcoCrop records no texture preference ('wide' or blank), so soil suitability is reported unavailable for this crop rather than scored full marks for every soil.
Kc ini is the Cereals group value (0.3). The Winter Wheat row is not used because Maharashtra wheat is not winter-dormant.
FAO-56 Table 12 has no black-gram row; the dry-beans/pulses row is used as a proxy.

_meta.standing_caveat: EcoCrop publishes global species-level envelopes. They are a citable improvement over invented numbers; the Maharashtra package-of-practices transcription (pop_transcribed.json) now provides local practice values for the crops it covers. local_review_needed lists every place where this build still knows the source is weak or conflicts with local practice.

sowing.window_basis: ICAR-IISR 2023 Table 2, Central zone row: '20th June-5th July'. NFSM 2018 gives the national rainfed window 'mid of June to end of June subject to availability of soil moisture/rainfall', quoted below.

quotes.label: Table 2, Central zone sowing time

quotes.text: Optimum time of sowing is from  mid of June to end of June subject to availability of  soil moisture/rainfall.
quotes.label: NFSM sowing time

pop.seed_rate_note: ICAR Central zone 65 kg/ha; NFSM 55-65 kg/ha. ICAR: raise to 75 for bold seed, lower to 45-50 for small seed.
pop.fertilizer_note: ICAR Central zone dose 25:100:50:50 NPKS kg/ha. NFSM publishes 25:60:40:30 for the north plains - recorded, not used, because Maharashtra is Central zone.
pop.soil_evidence: NFSM: soybean performs best on vertisols - black cotton soil (BLACK, a vertisol) is local optimal practice, overriding the EcoCrop global texture envelope.
pop.intercrop_note: Soybean + pigeon pea (tur) in 4:2 rows is the most popular rainfed intercrop in Maharashtra including Vidarbha.

quotes.text: Soybean can be grown on wide range of soils with better performance under vertisols rich in organic carbon.
quotes.label: NFSM soil preference (settles the EcoCrop conflict)

quotes.text: The optimum seed rate of 55-65 kg/ha with a spacing of 30-45 cm, which can be reduced with the use of broad-bed-furrow/ridge-furrow.
quotes.label: NFSM seed rate and spacing

quotes.label: ICAR Table 3, Central zone NPKS dose

quotes.label: NFSM nutrient dose (north plains - recorded for transparency, not used for Maharashtra)

quotes.text: +pigeon pea in 4: 2 combinations are most popular inter-cropping system under
quotes.label: ICAR soybean + tur 4:2 intercrop, rainfed Maharashtra

duration_days.citation: FAO-56 Table 11, row(s): Tropics (Dec planting) = 85 d; Central USA (May) = 140 d; Japan (June) = 150 d
duration_days.caveat: FAO-56 Table 11 is a cross-region envelope; the table itself states the lengths are examples from the listed regions and that local observations should be used. Read this as a plausible span, not a local figure.

water_need_class.method: seasonal_water_index = Kc mid (FAO-56 Table 12) x mid season days (FAO-56 Table 11). A relative consumptive-use indicator, not a millimetre figure.
water_need_class.limitations: Kc x duration does not capture puddling and percolation losses (rice), residual-moisture rabi cropping on stored soil water (safflower, gram), or conveyance losses. Treat the class as a coarse ordering, not a water budget.

quotes.text: Sowing time should be so planned that the flowering and seed filling stages of the crop do not coincide with continuous rainy period or high temperatures above 38°C.
quotes.label: NFSM sowing planning rule

pop.seed_rate_note: 5 kg/ha achieves 55,000 plants/ha on heavy soil and 74,000/ha on light soils; spacing 60x30 cm (45x30 for short-duration dwarfs).

quotes.text: A seed rate of 5 kg/ha is adequate to achieve required plant population of 55,000/ha under heavy soil and 74,000/ha under light soils.
quotes.label: NFSM seed rate and populations

duration_days.citation: FAO-56 Table 11, row(s): Sunflower, Mediterranean/California (Apr/May) = 130 d
duration_days.caveat: FAO-56 Table 11 is a cross-region envelope; the table itself states the lengths are examples from the listed regions and that local observations should be used. Read this as a plausible span, not a local figure.

water_need_class.method: seasonal_water_index = Kc mid (FAO-56 Table 12) x mid season days (FAO-56 Table 11). A relative consumptive-use indicator, not a millimetre figure.
water_need_class.limitations: Kc x duration does not capture puddling and percolation losses (rice), residual-moisture rabi cropping on stored soil water (safflower, gram), or conveyance losses. Treat the class as a coarse ordering, not a water budget.

soil_drainage_optimal.citation: EcoCrop 'Soil drainage' Optimal - advisory only in the MVP

soil_salinity.applied: SALINE soil is excluded from soil_types_optimal whenever the crop's optimal salinity band is low only, and excluded from soil_types_tolerated when the absolute band is also low only.

soil_types_optimal.method: Soils whose texture_class appears in EcoCrop's Optimal texture list. eco_credit 1.0

soil_types_tolerated.method: Soils whose texture_class appears only in EcoCrop's Absolute texture list. eco_credit 0.7

sowing.window_basis: Published band 'late September to mid of November' encoded with those bounds; the crop is rabi on residual soil moisture (same source, quoted).

quotes.text: could be sown from late September to mid of November
quotes.label: NFSM sowing window

quotes.text: Safflower is confined to residual moisture conditions during rabi season under Vertisols over an area of 0.18 million ha with production of 0.10 million tonnes
quotes.label: NFSM system description (vertisols, Maharashtra named in the sentence)

pop.seed_rate_note: Depending on soil conditions; spacing 30x15 or 45x20 cm.
pop.soil_evidence: NFSM describes safflower as grown on vertisols in rabi - black cotton soil (BLACK, a vertisol) is local optimal practice, overriding the EcoCrop global texture envelope.
